verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an audio-intelligence API, but the evidence shows no first-party rules engine, callbacks, or event-triggered actions. The Zapier, Make, and n8n integrations put the rule logic in third-party automation platforms, so they count as external workarounds rather than Gladia's own capability. Automatic PII redaction is an adjacent processing feature, not user-defined rules.
